title: Chapter 46
text: About the Author John Langan is the author of a previous novel, House of Windows (Night Shade, 2009), and three collections of stories: Sefira and Other Betrayals (Hippocampus, 2016), The Wide, Carnivorous Sky and Other Monstrous Geographies (Hippocampus, 2013), and Mr. Gaunt and Other Uneasy Encounters (Prime, 2008). With Paul Tremblay, he co-edited Creatures: Thirty Years of Monsters (Prime, 2011). One of the co-founders of the Shirley Jackson Awards, he served as a juror for their first three years. He lives in New York’s Hudson Valley with his wife, younger son, and a houseful of animals.
